name: HahlexMark & HahlexLockup
summary: Canonical normalized Vector SVG of Hahlex's Arch + 3 Pillars mark (4 official variants) paired with Title Case Geist 600 wordmark.

props.name: size
props.description: Mark width in pixels (aspect ratio 300:282 locked).

usageGuidelines: Use on-dark on Deep Espresso/Obsidian; use color or on-light on White/Cream.
Keep wordmark strictly Title Case 'Hahlex' in Geist 600.
responsiveBehavior: Crisp vector rendering at every DPI from 16px favicon to monumental poster scale.
exampleCode:
import { HahlexLockup } from "@hahlex/millar-marketing";

<HahlexLockup variant="color" size={28} sublabel="Millar" />

name: CoordinateGridSurface
summary: Hairline 1px framed container with precision corner registration crosshairs for technical specifications and structured layouts.
usageGuidelines: Pair with internal 1px hairline cell grids for architecture or compliance sections.
Do not stack consecutively on every section.
responsiveBehavior: Fluid container; crosshairs remain anchored 10px inside each corner at all widths.

name: DotMatrixField
summary: Calibrated SVG coordinate dot-matrix surface pattern in Warm Sand (light) or Warm Bronze (dark) with zero gradient bloat.

props.name: tone
props.description: Light cream or dark espresso surface tone.

usageGuidelines: Use as an understated structural backdrop behind focal statements or schematic plates.
responsiveBehavior: SVG pattern tiles seamlessly across any container width and height.
exampleCode:
import { DotMatrixField } from "@hahlex/millar-marketing";

<DotMatrixField tone="dark" spacing={22} height={180}>{children}</DotMatrixField>

name: ConcentricArcCanvas
summary: Static-first HTML5 Canvas rendering calibrated concentric shelter arcs, degree tick marks, and Hahlex's subtle three-pillar proportional echo.

props.name: height
props.description: Canvas display height in CSS pixels.

usageGuidelines: Renders once at crisp devicePixelRatio (max 2x) with zero continuous rAF CPU burn.
Ideal opposite editorial prose in EditorialEssaySplit.
responsiveBehavior: Scales smoothly to parent column width with DPR-calibrated stroke clarity.
exampleCode:
import { ConcentricArcCanvas } from "@hahlex/millar-marketing";

<ConcentricArcCanvas tone="light" height={280} caption="Measured Warmth · Plate 01" />

name: PaperTearDivider
summary: Procedural SVG torn-paper edge bridging Warm Cream editorial sections and Deep Espresso stages with zero raster payload.
usageGuidelines: Use sparingly (1-3 times per page) exclusively at major light-to-dark narrative shifts.
responsiveBehavior: preserveAspectRatio='none' stretches cleanly edge-to-edge across all viewports.

name: WarmHorizonWash
summary: Explicitly approved purposeful Marketing editorial wash (ADR-0002): restrained warm bronze radial horizon glow on Deep Espresso stages.

props.name: intensity
props.description: Calibrated radial alpha (0.14 subtle, 0.22 editorial) preserving >= 14:1 ivory text contrast.

usageGuidelines: ONLY approved gradient surface in Millar v0.1; strictly for Marketing heroes and stages, NEVER for Product UI.
responsiveBehavior: Full-bleed elliptical wash adapts proportionally to mobile and desktop stage ratios.

name: UnifiedOrbitDiagram
summary: Parametric SVG hub-and-spoke convergence diagram illustrating how distributed modules unify around one core layer.
usageGuidelines: Keep node labels concise (<= 14 characters) so pill geometry remains balanced without text clipping.
responsiveBehavior: Fluid viewBox 520x340 scales crisply inside Bento cells or split columns.
exampleCode:
import { UnifiedOrbitDiagram } from "@hahlex/millar-marketing";

<UnifiedOrbitDiagram centerLabel="Millar SSoT" tone="light" />

name: ClosedLoopSchematic
summary: Collision-free interactive N-step sequence loop with zero text-over-stroke overlap and automatic mobile rail stacking.
usageGuidelines: Replaces brittle hardcoded SVG track diagrams where text collides with curves or disappears on mobile.
responsiveBehavior: Auto-fit CSS grid flows cleanly from multi-column loop on desktop to single-column vertical rail on phones.
exampleCode:
import { ClosedLoopSchematic } from "@hahlex/millar-marketing";

<ClosedLoopSchematic activeStepId={step} onSelectStep={setStep} tone="dark" />

name: LayerStackDiagram
summary: Clean architectural layer stack explaining tiered dependencies without heavy 3D isometric clutter.

props.name: layers
props.description: Top-to-bottom stack layers with scope and package output identifiers.

usageGuidelines: Highlight the foundational bottom layer in --tone-brand-soft to anchor visual gravity.
responsiveBehavior: Stacks natively at 100% width with wrappable header/package badges.

name: BeforeAfterLedger
summary: Structured comparison ledger contrasting operational friction against verified Millar outcomes.
usageGuidelines: Pair Crimson strictly with the Before/Friction column header and Moss with the After/Outcome header.
responsiveBehavior: Three-column balanced ledger with readable wrap across desktop and tablet.

name: ProductWindowFrame & DataTableSpecimenFrame
summary: Stylized, crisp Hahlex application chrome rendered directly from Millar tokens for immediate 0%-scroll product proof.
usageGuidelines: Always populate with realistic plausible domain data and completed states; never show empty placeholder rectangles.
responsiveBehavior: Fluid framed viewport card maintaining legible padding on narrow mobile screens.

name: AssistantThreadPreview & MetricPlateCard
summary: Compact stylized AI assistant verification thread paired with full-surface MetricPlateCard tiles.

props.name: reply
props.description: Verified assistant response with check indicator.

usageGuidelines: Use at most once per marketing page; never repeat fake chatboxes across multiple sections.
responsiveBehavior: Stacks cleanly inside Bento columns and Stage panels.
